'''Trench''', designated '''Gamma-383''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="CWCG" /> Born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="Clone Databank" /> Gamma-383 was created to serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CWCG" /> Made from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Gamma-383 was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] who stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Clone Databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> During the war, he earned the nickname "Trench" from his habit of hunkering down and holding threatened positions for long periods of [[Time/Legends|time]]. At some point, Trench was assigned to follow the orders of a commanding [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in preparation for life as a member of a [[Clone commando/Legends|commando]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. Trench wore [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]], and carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and two [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|fragmentation grenades]].<ref name="CWCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trench was mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'', a supplement to the [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook|''Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition'']] published in [[2009]]. Trench is provided as a sample character to act as an ally, called a follower, for players.<ref name="CWCG" />
